Madhya Pradesh Electricity Duty Act, 1949 - Explanation (b) of Part B of Table of Rates of Duty to s. 3(1) -Interpretation of term "processing" under the definition of "mine" - Grievance of appellant pertains to definition of "mine" the effect of which is to make of higher rate of duty for "mines" (i.e. a composite activity of mining and processing) - Propriety of- Held: The word "processing" herein would mean those processes with help of hands or machineries connected and linked to mining activity- It would not include
